profile.headline: Software Developer II at PartsASAP
profile.summary: Earned a Bachelor of Science Degree in Information Technology in 2012 at which point I changed roles from solely a machinist to adding industrial automation to my plate.  Along with my manufacturing experience I create custom applications to suit business needs including data migration, data management, and data analysis.

positions.title: CNC Programmer / Machinist
positions.description:
Program Swiss lathes producing screws made of titanium and stainless steel

Develop high efficiency processes

Maintain DNC network

Quote manufacturing costs/manufacturing cost analysis

Lead operators in skills development

Initiate data driven manufacturing practices, removing opinion based decision making

positions.title: Manufacturing Systems Analyst
positions.description:
My main responsibilities are developing the DNC network connecting all CNC machinery and implementing tool tracking software. Also, I still perform all of the responsibilities I have as a CNC Machinist. My years of experience and software engineering degree have given me a unique set of skills that enables me to capture and use machine data to better company processes.

Knowledge of how Industrial Controls operate and how to install them
TCP/IP Networking fundamentals
Knowledge of RS-232 Communications, installation and troubleshooting
Programmable Logic Controllers(PLCs)
 Read and create ladder logic for PLCs
 Install PLCs
 Connect PLCs to controls
Understand wired and wireless networks functionionality and installation
Create and maintain databases using SQL, Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio
Completed Crystal Reports training at Dunn Solutions Group
Create reports and charts using Crystal Reports
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues on PCs, machine controls, PLCs, various networks, and Windows Servers
Script repetitive tasks and data migration to happen automatically
Create custom programs and services to perform business functions
Train users on using software/hardware
Create documentation for processes and installation of hardware 
Manage various data sources and repositories

positions.title: Cnc Machinist
positions.description:
Setup mills, lathes, hobbing machines, gear shaving machines, gear shaping machines

Read blueprints

Understand GD&T

Full knowledge of G-code

Write part programs

Optimize tool usage through studying feeds and speeds to find best scenario

Determine best tools for a job based on part complexities and machine capabilities

Train operators on how to run machinery, read prints, and use tooling effectively

Optimize machine cells with Lean Manufacturing principles

Complete all necessary paperwork including dimensional records and setup sheets

Supply my own tools and some inspection equipment

Completed GibbsCAM training at Midwest CAM Solutions

positions.title: Cnc Operator
positions.description:
Run mills, lathes, hobbing machines, gear shaving machines, and gear shaping machines

Offset machines to maintain dimensions on print

Inspect parts with all standard types of inspection equipment

Complete dimensional records and other paperwork

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering

projects.title: Custom LED Applications
projects.description: Use my knowledge of electronics to build custom LED lighting solutions for vehicles, in the home, and outside.  I've done cabinet and accent lighting in kitchens and vehicles with more to come.
